annotations.summary: An IRC Fiber container booted more than the allowed number of times
annotations.description: Counts gateway boot banners in container stdout (fluent-bit ships every /var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log on the prod host, and the collector's logs/ovh pipeline promotes container_name to service.name). A healthy container prints this once per deploy, so more than 2 in 10 minutes is a crash loop or an OOM kill cycle. Check: docker ps; docker inspect ircfiber-gateway | grep -E 'RestartCount|Health' ; docker logs --tail 200 ircfiber-gateway. This is the restart signal that needs no new receiver; rule 21 is the exact restart counter and needs the docker_stats receiver.

filter.expression: host.name = 'ovh-prod' AND body contains 'Starting IRC Fiber Gateway'
